main_measure.name: OLS slope of 2-bar excess return (15:00 UTC bar) on recorded forecast, pooled
main_measure.threshold: slope t >= 2 confirms (with supporting mean > 0, >= 1000 cases); t <= -2 rejects

supporting_check.name: mean of sign(forecast) x excess 2-bar return

decided_by: Slope t >= 2 and supporting mean > 0 from at least 1000 cases: the confirm rule.
reading: Cases are all bars stamped 15:00 UTC (including any with forecast 0) with close[t+2] taken two rows later in the same window; the coin's mean 2-bar return is pooled over all its windows on the non-overlapping grid 0,2,4,... of each window.
